title: Representation Destination
description: Seller-owned inventory context against which a CreativeRepresentationSet is resolved. This object is valid only when build_creative is invoked on the destination sales agent. The seller resolves product_id to its current product, verifies that format_option is an exact current effective declaration for the requested placements, and intersects it with its own current seller-wide execution capabilities. A standalone creative agent cannot use this object to claim seller deliverability.

verifier_constraints.seller_authority: the build_creative endpoint MUST be the sales agent that owns product_id
verifier_constraints.current_product_match: format_option MUST exactly match one effective current format option for product_id after every applicable placement and publisher narrowing
verifier_constraints.placement_scope: when placement_refs is omitted, the representation must satisfy the common effective contract for every placement where the product may deliver
verifier_constraints.execution_intersection: resolution additionally intersects the seller's current media_buy.execution.creative_specs VAST and macro ceilings; the request does not override those capabilities
verifier_constraints.tracker_execution_version: when a candidate contains first-class vast_tracker or daast_tracker assets and no sibling VAST/DAAST delivery document supplies one exact version, the matching execution_*_version is required, MUST belong to the destination acceptance set, and MUST be preserved in representation_selection; the seller MUST NOT guess or defer it to a later package

product_id.description: Product owned by the destination seller.

format_option.description: Exact effective destination declaration. The full declaration is carried so an option without format_option_id remains addressable. The destination seller verifies it against the current product and applicable placement/publisher narrowings.

placement_refs.description: Optional placements the derived manifest must satisfy. Omission means every placement in the intended product route, not an unconstrained destination.

execution_vast_version.description: Exact VAST execution version selected for seller-assembled first-class VAST trackers when no sibling exact-version VAST document supplies it. Must be accepted by format_option and is preserved in selection lineage.

execution_daast_version.description: Exact DAAST execution version selected for seller-assembled first-class DAAST trackers when no sibling exact-version DAAST document supplies it. Must be accepted by format_option and is preserved in selection lineage.
